name: San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 20, 2019 -
05:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Board Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the January 16, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-02-20 SDWD ITEM S08A MINUTES
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2019-02-20 SDWD ITEM S08B WARRANTS
8C.
Quitclaim of Access Easement on Parcel Number 267-163-10 and Execution of an Agreement for a Nonexclusive Easement across Parcel Number 267-163-11 to accommodate a Private Potable Water Service. Contact Person: Civil Engineer Knoll
1) Adopt Resolution No 2019-03, entitled “A Resolution of the Board of Directors of San Dieguito Water District Approving Quitclaim of Access Easement APN 267-163-10; 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Quitclaim Deed of Access Easement; and 3) Authorize the General Manager to execute an Agreement for a Nonexclusive Easement across APN 267-163-11.
2019-02-20 SDWD ITEM S08C EASEMENT AND QUITCLAIM ON PARCEL 268-151-31
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Presentation of Draft Results for the San Dieguito Water District's Water Rate. Contact Person: General Manager O'Donnell
District Board to take the following actions: 1) Review and discuss the draft results of the District's Water Rate Study; 2) Select one of the presented rate scenarios; and 3) Direct staff to schedule a public hearing on April 17, 2019 in compliance with Proposition 218 requirements to consider adoption of the new water rates and charges.
2019-02-20 SDWD ITEM S10A WATER RATE STUDY INTRODUCTION
10B.
Emergency repairs to the 30-inch transmission main in El Mirlo, Rancho Santa Fe. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
District Board authorize the payment of $82,980 to Burtech Pipeline for emergency repairs completed on the 30-inch transmission main in El Mirlo, Rancho Santa Fe.
2019-02-20 SDWD ITEM S10B EMGERGENCY REPAIR OF 30 INCH TRANSMISSION IN EL MIRLO
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
S12.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY BOARD MEMBERS
S13.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S14.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
S14A. General Manager Update/Report
S15.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MARCH 20, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
